story_text: As a user, I want to receive an error message when I enter an invalid email format during registration so that I know to correct it.

positive.title: Validating the registration with Invalid Email Format error message
steps: 2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an invalid email format (e.g., 'userexample.com') in the email field.
4. Enter a password in the password field.
positive.expected_result: An error message indicating the email format is invalid is displayed.

negative.title: Validating the registration with Invalid Email Format error message then correcting it
steps: 2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an invalid email format (e.g., 'userexample.com') in the email field.
4. Enter a password in the password field.
6. Correct the email format to a valid one (e.g., 'user@domain.com') in the email field.
negative.expected_result: The registration is successful with a confirmation message.

edge.title: Validating the registration with the minimum length using Invalid Email Format error message
steps: 2. Enter a name in the name field.
3. Enter an invalid email format with the minimum length (e.g., 'a@b.c') in the email field.
4. Enter a password in the password field.
edge.expected_result: An error message indicating the email format is invalid is displayed.
